invariant: The application startup gate may become ready only after the selected dynamic WebGL background has initialized and submitted one real error-free frame.
removedBehavior: No automatic eight-second promotion from mounting-agent to ready.
No automatic switch to the static background when the dynamic background is still pending.
No requestAnimationFrame dependency before the background payload can mount.
Runtime quality diagnostics no longer own the root startup lifecycle.

implementation.payloadMount: A macrotask releases the previous renderer before mounting the next background; cold-window requestAnimationFrame scheduling is not used as a prerequisite.
implementation.immersiveBackground: Initialization ends with a synchronous renderer.render call; an exactly-once ready callback follows only after that render succeeds.
implementation.theoryBackground: The runtime gate is followed by a synchronous first render and WebGL error drain; onFirstFrame is the startup-ready signal.
implementation.errorPath: Initialization and first-frame errors enter the explicit failed state. Errors after the first successful frame remain runtime errors and cannot roll startup back.
implementation.staticBackground: Available only as an explicit user diagnostic choice and never counted as a normal startup pass.
